motivation: User visual review found only presenter and swimmer plausible in the seven-clip pilot.
scope: Initial person-only screening; does not establish coverage of other subjects.
candidate_selection: All 7 official person prompts x 4 generators at seed 0, without model scores or detector outputs.
criteria: The intended main person is visually identifiable, not only an incidental hand or a tiny cropped fragment.
Inspect the first, middle and last decoded frame; permit motion and generated appearance defects.
A visibly structured background permits a meaningful background-blur intervention.
Image suitability, construction-mask correctness, and scoring-localizer correctness are reviewed separately.
Do not use Official/repair scores, score changes, or temporal stability to accept candidates.
after_screening: Review independent construction masks, freeze the eligible cohort and denominator before any new scoring; retain every exclusion with reason.
old_scores: All seven existing results remain pilot results; do not recompute a confirmatory conclusion on the two preferred samples.
frame_review_is_not: Full-video identity/contour ground truth, or subject-score validation.
